note: UR-09: one emotion per shot. The clause goes into the pod prompt; the grade drives the compositor. Values are engineering defaults (docs/UNIVERSAL_RULE_BASE.md).

discovery.label: discovery / wonder
discovery.light: one warm source, rim light, light shafts
discovery.clause: a single warm light source revealing the subject, glowing rim light, amber highlights against cool teal shadows

fear.label: fear / danger
fear.light: low, hard, from below or behind
fear.clause: low-key lighting, cold blue-green shadows, harsh single light from below, most of the frame in darkness

tension.label: tension / struggle
tension.clause: hard side light through dust haze, dusty orange and brown tones, strong contrast

joy.label: joy / triumph
joy.clause: golden hour light, warm saturated colours, bright open sky, soft glow

humour.label: humour / surprise
humour.clause: bright even daylight, clean light colours

calm.label: calm / rest
calm.clause: soft blue-hour light, small warm ember glow, gentle low contrast

sorrow.label: loss / sorrow
sorrow.clause: overcast flat light, muted grey-blue tones, desaturated
